claims.object_text: encodes the α-subunit (Gαo) of the heterotrimeric guanine nucleotide-binding protein (G protein)
claims.quote: The GNAO1 gene encodes the α-subunit (Gαo) of the heterotrimeric guanine nucleotide-binding protein (G protein).
Twenty-seven patients with variations in GNAO1 were analyzed (10 patients from Shenzhen Children's Hospital, 17 patients from previously published studies) including 12 boys and 15 girls.

claims.quote: The median age of onset was 3 months with moderate to severe global developmental delay.

Seizures typically presented as focal seizures in all patients with epilepsy.

Interictal electroencephalograms showed multifocal or diffuse epileptiform discharges.
The most common magnetic resonance imaging finding was widened extracerebral space.
